identity.design_principle: Information over Decoration. Function is Beauty.

usage_rules: Use Chivo for all major headings (Hero, Section Titles).
Use JetBrains Mono for all data points, file names, redacted text previews, and statistics.
Use Inter for instructions, body text, and privacy notices.
Headings must be white or off-white (#FAFAFA). Body text must be muted (#A1A1AA).

layout.spacing_system: Comfortable but technical. Use p-8 for cards, p-24 for section gaps.
layout.grid_strategy: Bento Grid for Stats. Single Column for Flow.

modes.bento_stats: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
modes.hero_centered: flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh] text-center

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast.

cards.style: Flat, minimal, 1px border. No heavy shadows. 'Tech' feel.
cards.base: bg-card border border-border rounded-lg p-6 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors

inputs.base: bg-input border-transparent focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-md h-11

upload_zone.base: border-2 border-dashed border-muted-foreground/25 hover:border-primary/50 hover:bg-primary/5 rounded-xl transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12

motion.hover: scale-105 for cards, glow intensity increase for buttons
motion.processing: infinite scan loop (top to bottom gradient)

images_and_media.strategy: Minimalist. Use abstract tech patterns or 3D icons sparingly.
images_and_media.usage: Use 'hero_background' as a subtle layer with low opacity behind the main upload section. Use 'privacy_icon' for the 'Privacy First' section or OG image.

rules: Focus states must be clearly visible (ring-2 ring-primary).
Red vs Green distinction must not rely solely on color (add icons/text).

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a single-page application. Focus on the 'Drop Zone' interactions. It must feel snappy and secure.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_setup: Force dark mode in tailwind config or root layout. This tool is 'The Stealth Utility'.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Customize Shadcn components to match the 'Obsidian & Electric' palette. Remove default radius if needed for a sharper look.
layout_structure: Hero: Title + Value Prop + Drag & Drop Zone.
Processing: Show a 'Scanning...' state with a progress bar and file name.
Results: Bento Grid of PII detected (Total, Aadhaar, PAN, etc.).
Footer: Privacy Notice + Tech Stack info.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Do not center align the app container globally.
